Myntmore runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and ABM for Coimbatore's pump, motor and engineering manufacturers, textile mills and machinery makers, and IT services firms. We work remotely from Mumbai, campaigns go live within 18 days, and the first qualified conversations usually arrive in weeks 3 to 4.

why.title: Engineering makers known at home, not abroad
why.desc: Coimbatore makes a large share of India's pumps and motors, along with castings, wet grinders and auto components. Many of these firms have a strong dealer network at home and almost no direct contact with overseas distributors and OEM buyers.

why.title: Textile mills facing new competition
why.desc: The city's spinning mills and textile machinery makers sell into a market where buyers can source from Bangladesh, Vietnam and Turkey. Reaching brands and sourcing heads with a specific capability is how a mill stays on the shortlist.

why.title: IT firms outside the big metros
why.desc: Coimbatore's IT and software services companies, including those at TIDEL Park, offer lower costs than bigger metros but have to prove themselves to buyers who have never heard of them. Outbound that leads with proof gets them the first call.
